rendered: In the BatPaC comparison (analysis in Fig. 2[1]), Co-free cathodes give a total pack cost of $8500 total pack cost[2] versus $10 000 total pack[3] for NCA, and a material cost of $3500 material costs[4] versus $5000 material cost[5] for NCA. So the total pack cost is lower by 1500[6] dollars, and the material cost is lower by 1500[7] dollars. Both reductions are the same amount.
